capabilities: Schedule one-shot and recurring reminders with desktop system notifications
Repeat notifications in nag mode until a reminder is checked off
Embed interactive reminder list widgets in notes via a simple-reminder code block
Browse and add reminders in an annual and monthly calendar view
Attach note and web links that open when a notification is clicked
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin store ("coming soon"); install manually or via BRAT. On iOS and Android, notifications only fire while Obsidian is open and active on screen. Exposes a public API documented in API.md. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fire scheduled notifications for tasks and deadlines, especially recurring ones with persistent alerts.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from Community Plugins

summary: Reminder plugin that schedules one-shot and recurring reminders with system notifications, a sidebar panel, calendar view, and embeddable note widgets.
